spiritgiven.comments: Good first match. No major calls made. Noticeable good defence and good runs made. Really enjoyed our dancing and good luck in the rest of the tournament!
High Complements from the team of the teams speed, teamwork, layouts and completed passes. We really enjoyed the game and the spirit the team brought. We wish you look for the rest of the tournament.
We really enjoyed playing such a high quality team, with really good pulls, deep shots and a range of athleticism. Good luck in the rest of the tournament!
Really good layouts, speed, accuracy in passing. High spirits. Thanks for such a good, fun game. Good luck in the rest of the tournament!
Good game. Great zone, very physical game but on both parts. Good luck in the rest of the tournament!
Great game. Great grabs, and adjustment to our zone. great spirit on and off the pitch. We wish you luck in the best of the tournament
Good game. Great speed, deep shots and pulls. Good luck in your next matches!
Great game. Great communication on all calls made . Loved getting to play you again!
Such a fun game. Deeps, d’s and your teamwork with your continuations and flows were so impressive. Thanks so much for such a good match!

spiritreceived.comments: Very well spirited team, they were always smiling and a joy to play against. Great game Ireland!!!!
Although when we score, Ireland team did praise us and did high five for us. It was a good spirit! Thank you for the good communication.

Appreciate the grit and hustle you showed throughout the game. Perhaps brushing up on the rules will help with gameplay especially because you guys are relatively new players! :-) Goodjob on the game today and all the best for the rest of the games!

We feel as if body awareness and self control & Rules knowledge and use could be improved - eg. foul call and players were still moving, some players on the mark wouldn’t put on stall counts
Overall a great spirited game - huge emphasis on the amazing positive attitude from everyone! Thank you girls :)
Your positive attitude throughout the game was amazing as well as how you fought for every disc! And we had an amazing time with you on the sideline :)

It was nice that you guys were always positive and calls were settled peacefully. Perhaps try to avoid contact during gameplay, but overall it was  great playing you guys again! Good luck for your next game :-)

Thank you for the great game. We felt as if your self control improved since our last game but rules knowledge and use could still be improved - eg. moving during a stoppage, in and out calls, making calls from the sidelines. Overall amazing game, thanks girls :)
